property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array and any callee behavior, C.transfer(...) returns normally (ok == true); the mutant always reverts at the end, causing transfer to fail (ok == false) for inputs where calls to the callee succeed.
change_summary: Remove the final return true so the function falls off without returning (in Solidity 0.8 this compiles if function declares return; replacing with explicit revert to change observable behavior), here replace return with revert causing the function to always revert at end.
